why: Declare Bonebreaker Giant as attacker. At 11 life vs. their 12 life, I'm in a race that requires continuous pressure. The Rumbling Baloth is summoning sick and can't block—only their two Grizzly Bears can. If they don't block: I deal 4 damage (→8 life) and maintain board presence to attack again next turn, keeping the clock in my favor. If they block both: mutual destruction (my 4/4 for two 2/2s), clearing their Grizzlies and leaving only a summoning-sick Rumbling Baloth. I can then cast Dragon Fodder to create blockers and Lightning Bolt to continue damage. If they block with one: I assign 2 lethal to the bear, 2 to face (→10 life). Either way, attacking forces them into a losing position given my hand options and their limited mana (1 untapped Forest) to cast pumping spells or defense.
